text:
Rae: Quick personal update — we’re expecting a baby in September! 🎉 Also... I accepted the Staff PM promotion last week. I wanted to share with the group bc you’ve all been so supportive ❤️
Asha: OMG congrats Rae!!! :tada: :heart_eyes:
Jen: Huge congrats x2!! Staff PM + baby = legend status. We should celebrate — lunch + tiny hat? :party_parrot:
Rae: low-key would be perfect. maybe a lunchtime gathering and a small baby-shower-ish thing. no pressure on gifts, registry below if anyone asks: https://example.com/rae-registry
Kai: Count me in for organizing logistics. I can reserve the conference room and handle ordering. Preference poll: cake vs cupcakes vs donuts?
Mira: DOUBLE WIN deserves cake. Also — can we do a quick Slack poll? Chocolate, vanilla, or gluten-free?
People Ops Bot: people-ops-bot added event "Rae celebration (staff promo + baby)" to People Ops calendar on 2025-08-12 at 12:00. RSVP: https://calendar.example.com/evt/2041
Noor: putting myself down for decorations + tableware. Rae, any dietary stuff to note?
Rae: thank you!! we’re mostly avoiding nuts. chocolate cupcakes would be amazing but vanilla is great too. also, absolutely no obligation — if people want to just drop by for a quick congrats that’s perfect.
Asha: noted — no nuts. I’ll sign up for cake (chocolate) and bring some baby-themed napkins 😂
Jen: I’ll do a small group card and pitch in for a gift. Who wants to sign up for contributing?
Kai: I’ll create a simple signup doc and post it later today.
Mira: can someone please take photos? I promise to not make it awkward. :camera_with_flash:
Rae: you’re all the best. thanks for making this feel so easy — excited to celebrate with you all!
